name: Uppdrag granskning
description: Swedish investigative journalism series known for the use of concealed cameras and microphones.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The search for one of the world's most infamous human traffickers began after the shipwreck off the island of Lampedusa in 2013, where 368 migrants died. Now a person is accused of being the so-called "General". But evidence show that there is a case of mistaken identities.

videos.title: Swedbank and the money laundering: Part 1
videos.overview: Swedbank's CEO promised that the bank wouldn't be drawn into the Danske Bank scandal. Now Mission Investigate reveals that Swedbank may well have been used for extensive money laundering - for nearly a decade.

videos.title: Swedbank and the money laundering: Part 2
videos.overview: A corrupt president and an infamous Russian oligarch. Mission Investigate can reveal new information about the people behind the suspected money laundering in Swedbank.

videos.title: Trans Train and the teenagers
videos.overview: The increase of teenage girls with gender dysphoria worry parents and health care staff in several countries – because of the lack of research on the new group of patients. What if the irreversible decision to undergo a gender correction is a mistake?

videos.title: Trans Train: Part 2
videos.overview: Swedish politicians argue that fifteen-year-olds with gender dysforia should be allowed to undergo gender reassignment surgery without consent from their parents. Otherwise ​they are at great risk of committing suicide. But is this really true? Mission investigate continues to investigate transgender health care and explore the arguments from politicians.

videos.title: Trans Train - Continues
videos.overview: Aleksa Lundberg, heartbreaking but full of dignity, said she would not have made the same decision now, while recognising there was no going back on the same day the programme was aired.

videos.title: Transbarnen (Trans Kids)
videos.overview: When Leo is 11 years old, doctors in transgender care start giving him puberty blockers. There are risks with the treatment, but his family are not informed of them. One day Leo says his body is aching. Mission: Investigate reveals what the doctors at Karolinska University Hospital knew, but didn’t reveal.
